Identity · E-commerce direction · Motion

Self-initiated concept / 2026

The challenge

Bring a nature-led lifestyle brand into focus without leaning on familiar wellness clichés.

The strategy

Build the experience around small, considered rituals. Give the story room to breathe before introducing the collection.

Art direction

Deep forest tones, organic photography, and a deliberate typographic contrast create a grounded visual language.

Development

A flexible collection and editorial design concept, built around readable information and fluid transitions.

Motion

Restrained image reveals, tactile hover states, and a deliberate reading rhythm. A still experience remains available for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

Final experience & results

A cohesive concept identity and digital direction. Commerce integration is outside the scope of this study.
